title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs, thinly sliced

steps.text: Toss the chicken with one tablespoon of the soy sauce and the cornstarch, and marinate for 10 minutes.
Stir the rest of the soy sauce together with the honey and sesame oil.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Sear the chicken for 5 minutes, until browned and cooked through, then set it aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and toss until glossy. Top with the green onions.
